newsitem.title: UK: Most UK gas interruptions to be restored Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Most UK gas interruptions to be restored Saturday.

text.p: British Gas plc pipeline division TransCo, which operates Britain's national Transmission System, will restore all gas interruptions from 0600 GMT on Saturday, with the exception of Network Sensitive Loads in three areas, a TransCo spokesman said on Friday evening.

There will still be interruptions to Network Sensitive Loads in the South Wales, East Midlands and North Western Local Distribution Zones (LDZs), but the spokesman added that demand is set to fall further. He speculated that there may not need to be any interruptions unless the weather deteriorates.
